release_notes: Vyzorix agent 0.1.4 (versionCode 4). Reduced-permission build: drops REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, SEND_SMS, RECEIVE_SMS, READ_LOGS, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES and CALL_PHONE so Play Protect no longer blocks the install. In-app OTA self-update is off; update by installing the new APK.
